title: Genesis 8:4-5 — ark rests on Ararat (7/17); mountaintops visible (10/1)
summary: Genesis 8:4-5 in English with the key dates colour-coded: the ark rested on the mountains of Ararat in the seventh month on the 17th day, and the mountaintops became visible in the tenth month on the first day. A summary line shows 7/17 (Ark rests) and 10/1 (Mountains visible).

text.text: 4 In the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.
5 The water decreased steadily until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains became visible.
